presentation.limitation: Three AgX is not the Blender Medium High Contrast look transform.

area.name: Blade B broad cool fill
area.conversion: Disk to equal-area rectangle. Source radiant power/(pi*area) used as initial numeric radiance; Three photometric calibration and shadows differ.

area.name: Blade B passage lift
area.conversion: Disk to equal-area rectangle. Source radiant power/(pi*area) used as initial numeric radiance; Three photometric calibration and shadows differ.

area.name: Blade B soft rim
area.conversion: Disk to equal-area rectangle. Source radiant power/(pi*area) used as initial numeric radiance; Three photometric calibration and shadows differ.

lighting.limitations: Physical source values exported; disk/rectangle shape, area-light shadows, indirect bounce and radiometric/photometric engine calibration are approximations requiring the runtime visual check.

hemisphere.qualification: Explicit S5 approximation of neutral daylight and broad passage fill, not an exported/baked Blender sky.

background.orientation: Three standard equirectangular, rotationY0. Source Blender texture has no explicit mapping rotation; pixel orientation parity not certified.

uvPolicy: Native UVs are unchanged and repeat. These Blender tile PNGs require TextureLoader flipY=true; no glTF V conversion was applied.
lightmapPolicy: The exported Blender Base Color graph is authoritative; no additional native lightmap is multiplied by the runtime.

runtimeLightingAdaptation.note: Runtime approximation of the neutral, non-camera world lighting. The approved orange panorama stays visible but supplies no environment illumination.
runtimeLightingAdaptation.colorConvention: Linear RGB arrays for Three.Color.fromArray; proposed by visual review, not sampled from an HDRI or native registry.
